notes: DEPLOYMENT milestone, not a new hardware spec. Pasqal inaugurated Italy's first neutral-atom quantum computer (third Pasqal EuroHPC system in Europe, after France and Germany): a 140-qubit Orion QPU ('SOL') tightly coupled to the EuroHPC Leonardo supercomputer at CINECA, Bologna. Supports CUDA-Q and Qiskit workflows via an open-source QRMI interface. No new gate-fidelity or logical-qubit numbers reported; 140q Orion is an existing Pasqal spec. Access requires EuroHPC/CINECA affiliation. RELEVANCE 2/5: neutral-atom 140q could host our 8q force circuits, but likely analog/digital hybrid and no fidelity data given. Related Pasqal records: HW-2026-011 (250q advantage), HW-2026-047 (Fresnel gen). Discovered_by hardware-tracker 2026-06-16.
